_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Waste Shipping Documentation
summary: The Waste Shipping Documentation provides the Government with waste tracking and receipt information for outgoing shipments of residual waste to a disposal or treatment facility.
use_relationship:
The Waste Shipping Documentation provides the Government with waste tracking and receipt information.
Residual waste shipping documentation for outgoing shipments of residual waste, from the contractor to a disposal site or to a secondary treatment or processing facility, allows the Government to review and approve outgoing waste shipments.
This data item description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the discrete task request as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Waste Shipping Documentation shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Waste Shipping Documentation for the transportation of the waste material to the treatment or disposal facility shall contain the following:

children.title: The signed Uniform Low-Level Radioactive Waste Manifest.
The completed signed copy of the Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest including the Hazardous Waste Report Management Method Codes.
The signed Asbestos Waste Shipment Record.
A draft copy of the Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest for residual shipments.
The draft residual waste Uniform Low-Level Radioactive Waste Manifest.
Any other applicable signed waste shipping documents.
